page.layout: Running head at the top, with the page number at the left. Below it, two medallion portraits side by side, each with its legend around the rim (left: ALEXANDER / TARTAGNVS; right: ANDREAS / BARBATIVS). Below them, one full-width block of two paragraphs. At the foot, a woodcut ornament, which is decoration and not transcribed.

main_text.p: ALEXANDER Targinus de Imola, siue Imolensis, Iu-reconsultus doctissimus claruit temporibus Friderici Imperatoris huius nominis tertij, & Sixti Papæ, huius nominis quarti, de quibus supra mentionem fecimus. Hic Alexander, in usum eorum qui iurisperitiæ operam dant aliquot libros conscripsit, quos nominatim descriptos habes apud Ioannē Trithemium.
ANDREAS Barbatias legum peritissimus, multa præ-clara in iure edidit opuscula, quorum nomenclaturam pores[?] etiam apud Trithemium legere.

page.notes: The medallion legends are set around the rims; the right one ends in "BARBATIV S", which is partly worn, so the final letters are doubtful. The word "pores" at the end of the first line of the second paragraph looks like "poteris" with a broken or missing portion, so it may be misread. The woodcut ornament at the foot carries no text. The running head has been converted from "PROMPTV. ICONVM" to u/v spelling as the rules require.
